summary: Complete testing of Machine Validation System for OEMLinker. All 16 backend tests passed including: has_complete_specs detection for CNC Lathe/VMC (complete/incomplete), validate_machine_for_job returning correct categories (fully_capable/unverified/wrong_type/too_small), PROCESS_MACHINE_COMPATIBILITY blocking wrong machine types, POST/PUT /api/machines auto-computing has_complete_specs, and GET /api/rfqs returning validation fields. Frontend verified: RFQDetail.jsx renders correctly with ExcludedVendorsSection component imported and validation badges ready for display.
critical_code_review_comments: machine_validation.py module correctly implements PROCESS_MACHINE_COMPATIBILITY matrix with 18 process types
has_complete_specs() correctly checks critical dimension fields per machine category (turning, vmc, hmc, boring, etc.)
validate_machine_for_job() returns proper categories: fully_capable, unverified, wrong_type, too_small
categorize_vendor_match() aggregates validation across all vendor machines
match_vendors() (lines 7460-7545) enriches matched vendors with validation_category and collects rejected vendors
RFQDetail.jsx correctly imports ExcludedVendorsSection and renders validation badges
ExcludedVendorsSection.jsx implements collapsible sections for unverified/too_small/wrong_type vendors
context_for_next_testing_agent: Machine validation system fully tested. Key test file: /app/backend/tests/test_machine_validation.py. The validation_category fields (fully_capable, unverified, wrong_type, too_small) are populated lazily when match_vendors() runs. Existing RFQs matched before the upgrade won't have these fields until re-matched. Frontend components ExcludedVendorsSection and validation badges in RFQDetail.jsx are ready and will display when data is present. Test data-testids: excluded-vendors-section, section-unverified, section-too_small, section-wrong_type, toggle-{category}, val-cat-{vendor_id}, validation-badge-{category}.
